title: NO KEY | God Mode | Auto Stronghold | Kill Player
features:
Cookie Hub for 99 Nights in the Forest brings survival tools, combat, farming, event automation, ESP, movement controls, and player actions into one searchable menu.

NO KEY at early launch — no key is required during the early launch period.

Survival

- God Mode
- Auto Heal
- Prevent Owl Chase
- Block Bat Scream
- Block Lava Damage
- Anti Self Sacrifice
- Block Snare Trap and Block Pitfall Trap
- Prevent Freezing
- No aggressive enemies collision and camera clip

Combat

- Kill Aura
- Auto Reload
- Auto Stunt Deer, Auto Stunt Owl, Auto Stunt Ram, and Auto Stunt Cat

Rescue and Revive

- Auto Rescue All Children
- Child Rescue Return Location
- Teleport to Selected Child, Rescue Selected Child, and Rescue All Children.
- Auto Revive Selected Player
- Revive and Revive All
- Bring Selected Body to Campfire and Bring All Bodies to Campfire.

- Fly
